AutoCAD-MCP third-party licence evidence bundle
=================================================

Scope: every third-party registry package in the exact locked Rust workspace.
Cargo.lock SHA-256: d7843ac81e247037cf8705ce46057b57c94769eb02613ad7ce018e876cf0fac3

This bundle reproduces the top-level LICEN[CS]E, COPYING, NOTICE, and
UNLICENSE files read directly from each cached .crate archive after verifying
its SHA-256 against Cargo.lock. The unpacked Cargo.toml must also equal the
archived manifest used for Cargo metadata. Metadata is not a substitute for retained licence
or notice bytes, and neither this bundle nor the SPDX inventory records legal
approval or a conclusion about distribution obligations.
